rubric.evidence: worker.js calls the pinned Transformers.js audio-classification pipeline, processor, and model; it returns genuine [1,2] raw logits through lib/worker-protocol.js. Route-complete refreshed acceptance evidence is recorded in acceptance-run.json when the validator exits 0.
The worker asserts exactly two finite raw logits, computes both softmax probabilities, and reports deterministic preprocessing metadata for exactly 80,000 samples (5.000 s at 16 kHz).

Actual loadPipeline call pins mirror SHA 6bea1eddcfca9842add425123f4955d5b4f153f7, q8 onnx/model_quantized.onnx (318,834,205 bytes); pages disclose canonical SHA 7a28165f33e1dbb37adbce09c0a9afcd6095dd4d and constrained-device limits.

All four routes use createModelLoader with revision included in cache identity. Shared loader now disposes the live instance and calls onDispose before clear/update removes assets; acceptance covers release/reinitialize and clear lifecycle.

Versioned WorkerClient uses unique request ids, maxInFlight=1/maxQueue=0, transferable audio copies, AbortSignal cancellation, stale suppression, and deterministic termination. Page finally blocks re-enable controls only when ready.

Overview and Basics provide approved sample, upload, mic fallback, classify and threshold controls. Practical intentionally exposes only a non-operational aggregate stability audit. Wild exposes only a conditional resampling probe. Loader release/clear controls remain shared.

Visible probabilities, deltas, crossings, raw logits and summaries are calculated from genuine xlsr-worker-result protocol responses. Wild says a crossing occurred only when top labels differ from the measured 1.00x baseline.

Native controls, labelled canvases/tables, role=status live regions, visible complete audio attribution and licence links are present on every route. Responsive scan reports no clipping/overflow; full matrix evidence is retained by acceptance screenshots.
scripts/responsive-check.mjs --slug ... reports automated-clean desktop and mobile; support remains needs-review until retained route-complete screenshots are manually inspected.

Inference and five-second preprocessing run in a module worker. Main-thread audio decode uses Web Audio; worker requests are bounded single-flight and transferable. The ~319 MB model and hundreds-of-MB RAM/storage limits are disclosed.

summary: Correction removes operational metadata matching/export, replaces copied multilingual media with one fully attributed LibriSpeech recording, pins the runtime revision, enforces five-second preprocessing, and makes worker/loader lifecycle deterministic. Practical and Wild now report model-risk sensitivity only, with explicit limits.
